item.title: Blit 0.2.13
item.description: Reliability fixes: a Wi-Fi route warning no longer fails a verified copy, a file that keeps failing its SHA-256 check stops retrying after three downloads, keyboard commands follow the pane you're in, idle server connections that dropped reconnect, and a hung network share can no longer freeze the window. Copies now report items they can't carry, such as sockets or broken links.
